            of being rejected with a 409.

              minimum: 0

              title: Membership level

              format: int32

            contactPreference:

                The owner's preferred contact channel. 'EMAIL' when an email
                address is present, otherwise 'PHONE'.
              type: string
              example: 'EMAIL'
              readOnly: true

              type: boolean
              example: false

              title: Pets
              description: The pets owned by this individual including any booked vet visits.

              items:

            - pets

components:
  schemas:
    ProblemDetail:
      title: Problem Detail
      description: The schema for all error responses.
      type: object
      properties:
        type:
          title: Type
          description: Full URL that originated the error response.
          type: string
          format: uri
          example: 'http://localhost:9966/petclinic/api/owner'
          readOnly: true
        title:
          title: Title
          description: The short error title.
          type: string
          example: NoResourceFoundException
          readOnly: true
        status:
          title: Status
          description: HTTP status code
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 400
          maximum: 600
          exclusiveMaximum: true
          example: 500
          readOnly: true
        detail:
          title: Detail
          description: The long error message.
          type: string
          example: 'No static resource api/owner.'
          readOnly: true
        timestamp:
          title: Timestamp
          description: The time the error occurred.
          type: string
          format: date-time
          example: '2024-11-23T13:59:21.3820407Z'
          readOnly: true
        schemaValidationErrors:
          title: Schema validation errors
          description: Validation errors against the OpenAPI schema.
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/ValidationMessage'
      required:
        - type
        - title
        - status
        - detail
        - timestamp
        - schemaValidationErrors
    ValidationMessage:
      title: Validation message
      description: Messages describing a validation error.
      type: object
      properties:
        message:
          title: Message
          description: The validation message.
          type: string
          example: "[Path '/lastName'] Instance type (null) does not match any allowed primitive type (allowed: ['string'])"
          readOnly: true
      required:
        - message
      additionalProperties: true
    Specialty:
      title: Specialty
      description: Fields of specialty of vets.
      type: object
      properties:
        id:
          title: ID
          description: The ID of the specialty.
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 0
          example: 1
          readOnly: true
        name:
          title: Name
          description: The name of the specialty.
          type: string
          maxLength: 80
          minLength: 1
          example: radiology
      required:
        - id
        - name
    OwnerFields:
      title: Owner fields
      description: Editable fields of a pet owner.
      type: object
      properties:
        firstName:
          title: First name
          description: The first name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}$"
          example: George
        lastName:
          title: Last name
          description: The last name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}\\.?$"
          example: Franklin
        address:
          title: Address
          description: The postal address of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        city:
          title: City
          description: The city of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 80
          example: Madison
        telephone:
          title: Telephone number
          description: >-
            The telephone number of the pet owner. On create it is normalized to
            E.164 form: spaces, dashes and brackets are stripped; a leading '+' and
            country code are kept when present, otherwise country code '+61' is
            assumed and a single leading '0' is dropped from the national digits. It
            must carry 8 to 15 digits after the '+'; the stored and returned value is
            that E.164 string.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          example: '6085551023'
        email:
          title: Email address
          description: >-
            The optional email address of the pet owner. When present it must be a
            syntactically valid address; it is stored and returned lower-cased. A
            present-but-invalid value is rejected with a 400.
          type: string
          format: email
          maxLength: 255
          example: george.franklin@example.com
        registrationDate:
          title: Registration date
          description: >-
            The date the pet owner was registered, in ISO 'YYYY-MM-DD' format.
            When omitted on create it defaults to the server's current date.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '2020-06-15'
        postcode:
          title: Postcode
          description: >-
            An optional 4-digit postcode. When present it must be valid for the
            owner's city region using the fixed table (NSW 2000-2099,
            VIC 3000-3099, QLD 4000-4099); a city with no known region accepts
            any 4-digit postcode. Stored and returned when given.
          type: string
          pattern: "^[0-9]{4}$"
          example: '2000'
        sharesHousehold:
          title: Shares household
          description: >-
            When true on create, allows an owner that shares a household with an
            existing owner — same last name and same address (compared
            case-insensitively with collapsed whitespace) — to be created instead
            of being rejected with a 409.
          type: boolean
          example: true
      required:
        - firstName
        - lastName
        - address
        - city
        - telephone
    Owner:
      title: Owner
      description: A pet owner.
      allOf:
        - $ref: '#/components/schemas/OwnerFields'
        - type: object
          properties:
            id:
              title: ID
              description: The ID of the pet owner.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            displayName:
              title: Display name
              description: The owner's name formatted as 'LastName, FirstName'.
              type: string
              example: 'Franklin, George'
              readOnly: true
            initials:
              title: Initials
              description: >-
                The upper-cased first letters of firstName and lastName,
                dot-separated with a trailing dot.
              type: string
              example: 'G.F.'
              readOnly: true
            locality:
              title: Locality
              description: >-
                The canonical region for the owner, read from the region segment of the
                customerCode (the part before the '-'), or 'UNKNOWN' when the postcode
                maps to no known region.
              type: string
              example: 'NSW'
              readOnly: true
            customerCode:
              title: Customer code
              description: >-
                The owner's customer code, formatted '<REGION>-<HASH8>' where REGION is
                the region code derived from the owner's postcode (NSW 2000-2099,
                VIC 3000-3099, QLD 4000-4099, else 'UNKNOWN') and HASH8 is the first 8
                upper-case hex characters of SHA-256 over the normalized telephone
                concatenated with the last name. There are no sequence numbers.
              type: string
              example: 'NSW-1A2B3C4D'
              readOnly: true
            checkDigit:
              title: Check digit
              description: >-
                A single Luhn check digit (0-9) computed over the digits
                contained in the customerCode.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              maximum: 9
              example: 7
              readOnly: true
            membershipNumber:
              title: Membership number
              description: >-
                The owner's membership number, formatted '<customerCode>-M<YY>'
                where YY is the last two digits of the registrationDate year.
              type: string
              example: 'NSW-1A2B3C4D-M26'
              readOnly: true
            householdId:
              title: Household ID
              description: >-
                A stable shared identifier for the household. Assigned when an owner is
                created with 'sharesHousehold' true — the joining owner and the existing
                owner(s) that share the household (same last name and same address,
                compared case-insensitively with collapsed whitespace) all carry the same
                value. Null for owners that do not share a household.
              type: string
              example: 'a1b2c3d4-e5f6-3a2b-8c9d-0e1f2a3b4c5d'
              readOnly: true
            identityKey:
              title: Identity key
              description: >-
                The single derived key used to detect duplicate owners, formatted
                'normalizedTelephone|email|householdId' where email is empty when absent and
                householdId is empty when the owner does not share a household. A create is
                rejected with a 409 only when its whole identityKey equals an existing owner's.
              type: string
              example: '+61412345678||'
              readOnly: true
            namesakeCount:
              title: Namesake count
              description: >-
                The number of existing owners, at the time this owner was created,
                that share the same firstName and lastName (compared
                case-insensitively).
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            membershipLevel:
              title: Membership level
              description: >-
                The owner's numeric membership level, computed on creation. Starts
                at 1, gains 1 when an email address is present, and gains 1 when the
                owner has no namesakes (namesakeCount is 0), capped at 3. Level 4 is
                reserved for tenure.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 1
              maximum: 3
              example: 3
              readOnly: true
            contactPreference:
              title: Contact preference
              description: >-
                The owner's preferred contact channel. 'EMAIL' when an email
                address is present, otherwise 'PHONE'.
              type: string
              example: 'EMAIL'
              readOnly: true
            bulkSignupWarning:
              title: Bulk sign-up warning
              description: >-
                True when more than 80 owners had already been created on this owner's
                registrationDate at the time this owner was created, otherwise false.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            pets:
              title: Pets
              description: The pets owned by this individual including any booked vet visits.
              type: array
              items:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/Pet'
              readOnly: true
          required:
            - pets

components:
  schemas:
    ProblemDetail:
      title: Problem Detail
      description: The schema for all error responses.
      type: object
      properties:
        type:
          title: Type
          description: Full URL that originated the error response.
          type: string
          format: uri
          example: 'http://localhost:9966/petclinic/api/owner'
          readOnly: true
        title:
          title: Title
          description: The short error title.
          type: string
          example: NoResourceFoundException
          readOnly: true
        status:
          title: Status
          description: HTTP status code
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 400
          maximum: 600
          exclusiveMaximum: true
          example: 500
          readOnly: true
        detail:
          title: Detail
          description: The long error message.
          type: string
          example: 'No static resource api/owner.'
          readOnly: true
        timestamp:
          title: Timestamp
          description: The time the error occurred.
          type: string
          format: date-time
          example: '2024-11-23T13:59:21.3820407Z'
          readOnly: true
        schemaValidationErrors:
          title: Schema validation errors
          description: Validation errors against the OpenAPI schema.
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/ValidationMessage'
      required:
        - type
        - title
        - status
        - detail
        - timestamp
        - schemaValidationErrors
    ValidationMessage:
      title: Validation message
      description: Messages describing a validation error.
      type: object
      properties:
        message:
          title: Message
          description: The validation message.
          type: string
          example: "[Path '/lastName'] Instance type (null) does not match any allowed primitive type (allowed: ['string'])"
          readOnly: true
      required:
        - message
      additionalProperties: true
    Specialty:
      title: Specialty
      description: Fields of specialty of vets.
      type: object
      properties:
        id:
          title: ID
          description: The ID of the specialty.
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 0
          example: 1
          readOnly: true
        name:
          title: Name
          description: The name of the specialty.
          type: string
          maxLength: 80
          minLength: 1
          example: radiology
      required:
        - id
        - name
    OwnerFields:
      title: Owner fields
      description: Editable fields of a pet owner.
      type: object
      properties:
        firstName:
          title: First name
          description: The first name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}$"
          example: George
        lastName:
          title: Last name
          description: The last name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}\\.?$"
          example: Franklin
        address:
          title: Address
          description: The postal address of the pet owner.
          type: string

## Summary

I implemented the age-band feature on the `POST /api/owners` create flow so that a request may include an ISO `birthDate` and the owner's response carries a derived `ageBand`.

**Changes made:**

1. **`openapi.yml`** (the source of the generated DTOs):
   - Added optional `birthDate` (`format: date`) to the `OwnerFields` request schema.
   - Added read-only `ageBand` (string: `MINOR`/`ADULT`/`SENIOR`) to the `Owner` response schema.

2. **`Owner` entity** (`model/Owner.java`): added a persisted `birthDate` field (`@Column(name = "birth_date")`) with getter/setter, so the value survives a round-trip and `ageBand` can be recomputed on every `GET`.

3. **DB schemas** (`db/{hsqldb,h2,mysql,postgres}/schema.sql`): added a `birth_date DATE` column to the `owners` table. Tests run on hsqldb; the others are updated for consistency.

4. **`AgeBand` helper** (`function/owner/AgeBand.java`): new pure function computing the band from completed years between `birthDate` and `registrationDate` — `MINOR` (<18), `ADULT` (18–64), `SENIOR` (65+), returning `null` when no `birthDate` was supplied so the field is simply omitted.

5. **`OwnerMapper`**: added a `@Mapping` expression that derives `ageBand` via `AgeBand.of(owner.getBirthDate(), owner.getRegistrationDate())`, mirroring how the other computed read-only fields (e.g. `membershipNumber`) are wired. `birthDate` itself maps automatically by name in both directions.

**Design notes:** Because `ageBand` is computed against `registrationDate` (which the pipeline defaults/business-day-adjusts on create), both dates are persisted and the band is derived purely in the mapper at read time — matching the existing convention for derived fields rather than adding a persisted column or extra pipeline step. No `@RestController`/Spring MVC was introduced; the existing OfficeFloor pipeline for `owners.POST.yml` already binds and persists the request body, so no YAML changes were needed.

The acceptance test (`birthDate: 1990-01-01` → `ageBand: ADULT` against a 2026 registration date) and the full suite pass.
